    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">新组件库fi发布，轻松实现新一代声明式信息图可视化</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<center style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: bold; padding-top: 40px">更多Dash应用开发干货知识、案例，欢迎关注“玩转Dash”微信公众号👇</center>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1344061/202507/1344061-20250703190053776-1837084116.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h1 id="1-简介">1 简介</h1>
<p>大家好我是费老师。<code>Dash</code>作为<code>Python</code>生态中强大的<em>全栈应用开发框架</em>，依托于其丰富✨的<em>组件库生态</em>，使得我们可以纯<code>Python</code>实现各种各样丰富的应用功能。</p>
<p>今天的文章中要给大家介绍的，就是我们近期正式发布的<em>信息图可视化</em>组件库<code>feffery_infographic</code>（下文中简称<code>fi</code>）：</p>
<ul>
<li>Github仓库地址：<a href="https://github.com/HogaStack/feffery-infographic" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/HogaStack/feffery-infographic</a></li>
<li>Gitee镜像同步仓库地址：<a href="https://gitee.com/cnfeffery/feffery-infographic" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://gitee.com/cnfeffery/feffery-infographic</a></li>
</ul>
<center><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1344061/202601/1344061-20260113110308476-1250406414.png" width="50%"></center>
<p>底层基于当下<em>AI应用领域</em>非常热门🔥的信息图可视化框架<code>AntV Infographic</code>，提供了大量新颖美观的新型信息图可视化功能，非常适合用于<em>智能商业分析</em>等当下炙手可热的AI应用场景：</p>
<center><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1344061/202601/1344061-20260113110310355-734265341.webp"></center>
<h1 id="2-feffery-infographic的使用">2 feffery-infographic的使用</h1>
<p><code>fi</code>的安装非常简单，终端执行下列命令完成最新版本安装：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">pip install feffery-infographic -U
</code></pre>
<p>我们主要使用<code>fi</code>里的<code>Infographic()</code>组件渲染<em>信息图可视化</em>，其本质是基于<em>信息图语法</em>来生成商业分析可视化，下面是一个简单的例子，执行<code>python app.py</code>运行：</p>
<center><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1344061/202601/1344061-20260113110312305-1357565079.png"></center>
<pre><code class="language-Python">import dash
from dash import html
import feffery_infographic as fi

app = dash.Dash(__name__)

app.layout = html.Div(
    [
        fi.Infographic(
            # 定义信息图语法
            syntax="""
infographic list-row-simple-horizontal-arrow
data
  items
    - label 步骤 1
      desc 开始
    - label 步骤 2
      desc 进行中
    - label 步骤 3
      desc 完成
""",
        )
    ],
    style={'padding': 50},
)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    app.run(debug=True)
</code></pre>
<p>其核心参数<code>syntax</code>用于定义所绘制的<code>信息图类型</code>、<code>信息图主题</code>、<code>信息图风格</code>等视觉要素，对应的<em>信息图语法</em>类似<code>mermaid</code>图表语法。</p>
<ul>
<li>参考资料：<a href="https://infographic.antv.vision/learn/infographic-syntax" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://infographic.antv.vision/learn/infographic-syntax</a></li>
</ul>
<center><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1344061/202601/1344061-20260113110314110-1854883562.png"></center>
<p><code>fi</code>可实现<code>AntV Infographic</code>中目前支持的<strong>数百种</strong>不同类型的商业分析信息图：</p>
<ul>
<li>参考资料：<a href="https://infographic.antv.vision/gallery" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://infographic.antv.vision/gallery</a></li>
</ul>
<center><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1344061/202601/1344061-20260113110315825-292968896.png"></center>
<p>更典型的使用场景是在<em>大模型</em>驱动的智能分析应用中，由AI负责根据实际要求自动生成信息图语法，这里你可以利用到<code>fi</code>中内置的<em>系统提示词</em>作为参考：</p>
<pre><code class="language-python">from feffery_infographic.prompts import base_prompt, base_prompt_en

# 中文版提示词
base_prompt

# 英文版提示词
base_prompt_en
</code></pre>
<p>除此之外，<code>fi</code>中的信息图组件还支持<em>可编辑</em>、<em>图片下载</em>、<em>流式更新</em>等高级功能，具体参数说明及使用示例请移步文档：</p>
<ul>
<li>Github仓库地址：<a href="https://github.com/HogaStack/feffery-infographic" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/HogaStack/feffery-infographic</a></li>
<li>Gitee镜像同步仓库地址：<a href="https://gitee.com/cnfeffery/feffery-infographic" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://gitee.com/cnfeffery/feffery-infographic</a></li>
</ul>
<p>更多参考资料：</p>
<ul>
<li>信息图语法在线编辑器：<a href="https://infographic.antv.vision/editor" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://infographic.antv.vision/editor</a></li>
</ul>
<p>篇幅有限，更多基于<code>fi</code>的智能分析应用开发实战案例，我们将在后续文章中陆续更新，敬请期待~</p>
